verses.text: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea, while Herod was king. Then some wise men from the east rolled into Jerusalem.
They asked, “Where’s the child born to be King of the Jews? We saw his star rise in the east, and we came to worship him.” ⭐
When King Herod heard that, he was rattled—and all Jerusalem felt the tension with him.
Herod called together all the chief priests and teachers of the people and asked them where the Messiah was supposed to be born.
They told him, “In Bethlehem, Judea. The prophet wrote:”
“‘Bethlehem, in Judah’s land, you’re no small name among Judah’s leaders. A ruler will come from you, and he’ll shepherd my people Israel.’”
Then Herod secretly called in the wise men and got the exact time the star had appeared.
He sent them to Bethlehem: “Go search carefully for the child. When you find him, come tell me, so I can go worship him too.”
They heard the king out and headed off. Then the star they’d seen in the east went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
When they saw the star again, their joy was off the charts.
They entered the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother. They bowed down and worshiped him, then opened their treasures and gave him gold, frankincense, and myrrh. 🎁
A dream warned them not to go back to Herod, so they took another route home to their own country.

After they left, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream: “Get up. Take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, because Herod is about to hunt for the child and destroy him.”
Joseph got up that night, took the child and his mother, and left for Egypt.
He stayed there until Herod died. That fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “I called my son out of Egypt.”

Herod realized the wise men had outplayed him, and he was furious. He ordered every boy two years old and younger in Bethlehem and the surrounding area killed, using the timing he’d learned from the wise men. 💔
That fulfilled what the prophet Jeremiah had spoken:
“A cry was heard in Ramah—grief, tears, and deep mourning. Rachel was crying for her children and couldn’t be comforted, because they were gone.”
After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
The angel said, “Get up. Take the child and his mother and go to Israel, because the people trying to kill the child are dead.”
Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went back to Israel.
But when he heard Archelaus had taken over Judea after his father Herod, Joseph was afraid to go there. A dream warning sent him toward Galilee instead.
He settled in a town called Nazareth. That fulfilled what the prophets had spoken: he would be called a Nazarene.
